transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Brooks. Here's what I found in my classroom trial. I ran the trial with all of my 9th-grade sections over a two-week period, and I recorded 23 phone-related interruptions during that time. That's a significant number of disruptions affecting instructional time. However, I also tested numbered locking pouches with my students, and I found that they noticeably reduced interruptions compared to the open bin approach. Based on these findings, I'd like to recommend that we consider a grade-9-only pilot rather than including grade 10 at this stage, and that we use one numbered locking pouch per student instead of the open classroom bins currently suggested in the draft proposal. I believe this approach would give us cleaner data and a more effective intervention for the students who need it most. I should note that I documented these recommendations in my team notes, but they haven't yet been incorporated into the draft proposal.
